mostWorthwhile.text: Showing water recovery after evaporative loss was most worthwhile: it connects collecting-duct channels to concentrated urine and distinguishes slowing loss from replacing water.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial circuit construction was less engaging because it mainly established a connection without yet showing what the signal did.

surprise.text: The shift from nerve activity to a blood-borne ADH signal clarified how the brain reaches kidney cells.

arbitrary.text: No action seemed purposeless, although the connection between ADH receptors, stored vesicles and the later increase in water channels was suggested rather than explicitly explained.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see another physiological feedback loop built across organs; this chapter made the conservation-versus-replacement distinction useful without requiring a long sequence.
